abstract: Maintains statutory inter-agency notification protocols and formal data-sharing clearances
system_message:
You are Environmental compliance officer (COMP). The Environmental compliance officer (COMP) maintains statutory inter-agency notification protocols and formal data-sharing clearances, while also tracking chain-of-custody transfer metrics across investigative teams.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Chain-of-custody tracking（AUDIT）
information_points.content:
COMP-AUDIT-OES：Multi-depth groundwater tracer tomography records a custody transfer verification rate of 100% for sample handovers verified within one hour across investigative sample manifests transferred between survey teams.
COMP-AUDIT-PAK：Nested discrete-interval acoustic profiling achieves a custody transfer verification rate of 90% for sample handovers verified within one hour across investigative sample manifests transferred between survey teams.
COMP-AUDIT-9HU：Direct-push membrane interface sounding demonstrates a custody transfer verification rate of 95% for sample handovers verified within one hour across investigative sample manifests transferred between survey teams.

information_points.title: Maintains statutory inter-agency notification protocols and formal data-sharing clearances（LEGAL）
information_points.content:
COMP-LEGAL-DER：For Nested discrete-interval acoustic profiling evaluated in the Production portal regulatory data exchange environment, regulatory agency data-sharing clearance is false, as diagnostic telemetry does not satisfy statutory evidentiary admissibility requirements on the State Department of Environmental Protection enforcement docket.
COMP-LEGAL-W7Y：Evaluated under the Staging portal regulatory data exchange environment, Direct-push membrane interface sounding shows a regulatory agency data-sharing clearance of false regarding statutory evidentiary admissibility for the State Department of Environmental Protection enforcement docket.
COMP-LEGAL-62A：Within the Production portal regulatory data exchange environment, Multi-depth groundwater tracer tomography holds a regulatory agency data-sharing clearance of true, verifying that diagnostic telemetry fulfills evidentiary admissibility criteria for the State Department of Environmental Protection enforcement docket.
COMP-LEGAL-JNS：For the Direct-push membrane interface sounding protocol under the Production portal regulatory data exchange environment, regulatory agency data-sharing clearance is confirmed true based on telemetry compliance with statutory evidentiary admissibility requirements for the State Department of Environmental Protection enforcement docket.
